restriction: Require either a treatment count m fixed almost surely, 0<m<N, with every actual unit marginal m/N, or an assignment law on proper nonempty subsets uniform conditional on its treatment count. This includes complete individual randomization and independent common-p individual assignment conditioned on nonempty arms. Arbitrary equal-marginal dependent laws with varying counts are not covered.
